headline: 麥克莫爾辦巴勒斯坦義演
context: 美國饒舌歌手麥克莫爾（Macklemore，本名 Benjamin Haggerty）宣布展開「自由巴勒斯坦」巡演，首站將在都柏林登場，之後會到巴黎、倫敦，北美場次則待公布。這場巡演的收益，將捐給支援巴勒斯坦的人道救援組織。麥克莫爾上週才因在紅髮艾德（Ed Sheeran）的美國體育場巡演上，公開聲援巴勒斯坦而遭到除名。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: The US rapper, removed from Ed Sheeran’s US stadium tour after voicing support of Palestine, has convened a charity show that will visit Dublin, Paris and London, with a North American run to be announced Macklemore has announced a “Free Palestine” tour, a series of live shows that will feature the US rapper performing alongside musicians and friends to raise funds for humanitarian causes in Palestine. The news comes after Macklemore (AKA Benjamin Haggerty) was removed from Ed Sheeran’s US stadium tour after he called for a “free Palestine” onstage and said he wanted the people of Gaza and “the occupied West Bank” to know “we have not forgotten about them”. Continue reading...
sources.title: Macklemore announces Free Palestine tour to benefit humanitarian aid organisations

sources.name: The New York Times
sources.summary: The rapper, who was pulled from Ed Sheeran’s tour last week over his support for Palestinians, announced plans for three European dates.
sources.title: Macklemore Announces ‘Free Palestine’ Concerts After Exiting Ed Sheeran Tour

sources.name: BBC
sources.summary: Proceeds from the tour, which begins in Dublin next month, will go to organisations supporting Palestinians, he says.
sources.title: Rapper Macklemore announces 'Free Palestine' tour after Ed Sheeran fallout

sources.name: Al Jazeera
sources.summary: Macklemore says 'being apolitical during a genocide doesn’t work', promises to donate proceeds to Palestinian causes.

voice_text: 美國饒舌歌手麥克莫爾，宣布展開一系列「自由巴勒斯坦」巡演。首站訂在都柏林，接著會到巴黎跟倫敦，北美場次之後才會公布。這趟巡演的收入，會捐給支援巴勒斯坦的人道救援組織。他上週才因為在紅髮艾德的美國體育場巡演上，公開聲援巴勒斯坦，被對方除名。麥克莫爾也提到，他認為在他所說的這場種族滅絕當中，假裝政治中立是行不通的。
